item: A1 — PDF / DOCX / TXT ingestion with page numbers and character spans

hardware.NOT_the_published_bench_machine: V02_REPORT.md figures were measured on 2 vCPU Xeon (AVX-512) / 8 GB. Nothing here may be merged with those.

acceptance_criterion: a 20-page PDF with a table and one scanned page yields correct clauses and page references

fixture.deterministic: byte-reproducible across builds; asserted by test_it_is_byte_reproducible
fixture.page_19: annex table, rendered as spaced text the way a real manual's table reaches a text extractor
fixture.page_20: IMAGE ONLY — 0 text-layer characters, verified by test_the_last_page_has_no_text_layer_at_all, so the OCR path is genuinely exercised

ocr_fidelity_on_this_fixture.scope_limit: A cleanly rendered 300 dpi synthetic page. Real scans are noisier; this is NOT evidence that OCR preserves digits in general, which is precisely why clauses carry extraction='pdf_ocr' rather than being folded into 'pdf_text'.

design.exact_span_invariant: page_text[char_start:char_end] == clause.text, asserted for EVERY clause including OCR'd ones
design.ocr_is_labelled_not_merged: extraction is part of Clause. OCR misreads digits and this pipeline drafts thresholds from clause text, so an OCR'd value belongs in the hypothesis class put to the expert, never in evidence.
design.missing_ocr_tool_is_refused: a silently skipped scanned page is a clause the expert never sees; the refusal names the apt package
design.docx_pages: DOCX has no pages before layout, so the body is page 1 and that is stated rather than a page number being guessed

python.name: Pillow
python.used_for: rendering the fixture's scanned page only

rejected.name: pdfplumber
rejected.reason: pulls pdfminer.six, which pulls cryptography. pypdf gives the page text and page numbers the contract needs with one transitive.

rejected.name: pytesseract
rejected.reason: a subprocess wrapper around a binary the ingester already shells out to; a dependency with no added capability.

findings.what:
PDF line wrapping puts newlines inside phrases, so a clause reads 'between 10
C and 25 C'
findings.consequence: any downstream quantity parser must treat an intra-phrase newline as a space or it will miss the value
findings.status: pinned by test_clause_text_can_contain_newlines_from_pdf_wrapping so it cannot surprise whoever writes the field parser

findings.what: tesseract and poppler are apt packages, not pip
findings.consequence: an air-gapped bundle must carry their .deb files; apt-get is unavailable on the target host
findings.status: recorded in requirements.lock's SYSTEM section and in this file

offline: no network call and no model: pypdf reads the text layer, pdftoppm rasterises, tesseract reads. Verified by construction — none of the three opens a socket.
